machines.name: Test-only installed Pi runtime and CLI discovery
machines.scope: qualification/test helper only; not installed product behavior
machines.state_storage: In-process PATH cursor, selected executable, ancestor/adjacent package scan and manifest bin field; read-only filesystem observations

transitions.guard: nonempty PATH entries; platform native names pi.cmd/pi.exe/pi.ps1/pi on Windows, pi elsewhere
transitions.effects: Try X_OK for each spelling until first accessible executable in an entry.
transitions.failure_retry: Access failure tries next spelling/entry; no npm command, config lookup or named override is used.

transitions.guard: at most8 ancestor directories; first package.json whose name is @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
transitions.effects: Return package directory associated with resolved executable ancestry.
transitions.failure_retry: realpath/read/JSON failure propagates; an existing malformed manifest does not simply count as not found. No version/hash check in this helper.

transitions.guard: entry/node_modules package or node_modules/.bin sibling; dist/index.js and matching-name package.json exist
transitions.effects: Return realpath of matching adjacent package.
transitions.failure_retry: No matching package proceeds to next PATH entry; exhausted search throws explicit not-discoverable error.

transitions.guard: manifest bin is string or object.pi is string
transitions.effects: Return realpath(resolve(packageRoot, declared bin)); no host process is launched.
transitions.failure_retry: Absent bin throws; read/parse/realpath error propagates. This helper does not separately check version/hash, executable permission or containment of declared bin; caller qualification is distinct.

machines.overlap: Release-ci C26/C27/C36 covers higher-level Pi promotion/evidence/benchmark admission; surfaces runtime resolver covers product runtime selection. This PATH package/CLI fixture discovery seam was not separately enumerated in those ledgers.

classification.classification: Already-covered benchmark protocol producer; no new state family
classification.observed: Rejects samples other than integer100. Imports production wrapBuiltins but supplies fake native factories, allow-only BridgePort, always-true trust/audit/confirm and fixed benchmark session. Registers wrappers, emits ready with count/time, runs105 sequential calls over read/bash/write corpus, discards first5 timing values, emits complete with100 timings and bridge/native call counts.
classification.boundary: This measures the real TypeScript wrapper with stub bridge/native tool work, not actual Python spawn, filesystem mutation, Git execution or live host behavior. Imported product guard behavior belongs to surfaces ledger. No extra failure handler or timeout is defined in this helper; parent benchmark owns timeout/result validation.

boundaries: All new transitions are qualification/test tooling, not installed product runtime behavior.
C36 already accounts for the benchmark ready/complete and100-measured+5-warmup protocol; no duplicate benchmark family added.
